label: Aristotle, Physics III.2, 202a9-12: A mover, insofar as it acts as mover, carries a form that…
interpretation: Form-as-source reading: the mover qua mover brings or carries a form that is source and cause of the change. The human-generates-human example supports the relation, but this claim does not identify every efficient cause with a form or collapse Aristotle's causal modes.
